QuestInfo.name: Gaining Ephenia's Trust 1
QuestInfo.0: Keep talking to Ephenia the Fairy Queen.
QuestInfo.1:
Ephenia wants you to prove that you're trustworthy.

(Go to #r#m302020200##k and eliminate #b10 Hidden Grave Robbers#k and #b10 Grave Robber's Hunting Dogs#k.)
QuestInfo.2: You defeated 10 Hidden Grave Robbers and 10 Grave Robber's Hunting Dogs.

0.0: If you're truly a good person, prove it right here, right now. A whole legion of grave robbers are defiling the final resting place of the fairies. Rid us of their opportunistic stink, and I will consider your words. Though I doubt you will.

yes.0:
I'll be here when you inevitably fail.

(Go to #r#m302020200##k and eliminate #b10 Hidden Grave Robbers and #b10 Grave Robber's Hunting Dogs#k.)

1.0: Have you vanquished the villains? Or did you choose to join them?

yes.0: So...perhaps you're not as bad as I thought. You...you kind of have his eyes.

mob.0: Humans are vile...\r\n\r\n(Go to #r#m302020200##k and eliminate #b10 Hidden Grave Robbers and #b10 Grave Robber's Hunting Dogs#k.)
